root_motion: MOTION owns horizontal displacement only; PELVIS holds full orientation including inversion. No yaw extraction singularity during a roll. Place the entire glTF scene in an instance wrapper.
ground_policy: Complete avatar is translated vertically each frame so its lowest rigid armor vertex is 15 mm above a flat floor. No foot locks, no standing pose constraint, no limb stretching; this is a measured presentation correction, not physical contact IK.

visual_review.finding: Approach and knuckle gait are coherent while visible. Upper torso leaves frame after roughly 5 s; ending becomes an extreme face close-up, so late full-body pose is speculative completion rather than faithful mocap.

ground_contact_drift_proxy.definition: Horizontal displacement between adjacent 30Hz samples when the same sole socket/hand joint is below 15cm at both samples. This is an unverified near-ground proxy, not labelled contact truth or a physical error metric. Robot armor may touch before the measured joint.
